scope: Provided registered/resampled coronal-oblique source grids, no native-patient diagnosis or volumetry

meshSchema.header: ASCII[4] magic, uint32 vertexCount, uint32 triangleCount, uint32 reservedZero
meshSchema.positions: float32[vertexCount*3], source voxel-index coordinates (half integers), 12*vertexCount bytes
meshSchema.winding: Outward AFTER applying original source affine. Source index affine has negative determinant; source-index cross products alone have opposite handedness.
meshSchema.normalOracle: For each world-space triangle, normalize(cross(P1-P0,P2-P0)); flat per-face normal. Equivalently normalize(sourceVoxelOutwardRowVector @ inverse(affine3x3)). Do not average normals for categorical voxel-cell display.
meshSchema.GPUProofRequirement: Compare decoded full source positions and ordered face indices against positionByteSHA256/indexByteSHA256, then independently apply affine/camera transforms to inspect actual uploaded GPU buffers. Transport proof alone does not prove rendered buffers.

classNotes: Published hippocampal grey-matter label; CA1–CA4 and subiculum are not separately labelled.
Combined entorhinal and parahippocampal boundary context (author class: medial temporal neocortex); not complete medial temporal cortex.
Pial-boundary class used by the source method; not a segmentation of the whole meninges.
Hippocampal–amygdalar transition area (HATA); not the whole amygdala.
Indusium griseum posterior boundary context; not complete fornices or mammillary bodies.
The authors’ cyst label; its presence does not establish a clinical diagnosis or benignity.
Dentate granule-layer / endpoint label used by the source method; not the whole dentate gyrus, hilus or CA4.
